explication: wtfis is a command-line OSINT lookup tool for domains, hostnames, and IP addresses. The main flow parses configuration, selects an entity handler, fetches VirusTotal and optional provider enrichments, then formats the collected results as terminal panels. IP and domain lookups have distinct handler stages; provider-specific clients and normalized response models support enrichment, while the UI presents the results. The README documents the provider capabilities. Some handler and client implementations were not excerpted, so those documented relationships use README evidence rather than assumed call chains.
